title: Contrapunctus IX

captions.text: ☞ Subject I alone, in the alto: an octave leap, then a running line.
☞ The answer in the soprano, on A.
☞ The answer in the tenor: all four voices are in.
☞ Subject II in the soprano: the main subject in long notes, over I.
☞ Subject II in the tenor, now below subject I: the pair turned over.
☞ Subject II in the alto, over subject I in the bass.
☞ Subject II in the bass, under subject I in the soprano.
☞ The last entries: subject II in the alto, subject I in the tenor.

listenFor: a fast new subject, then the main subject in long notes against it
